s6d869caeeb5f21: Xinference is an enterprise-level model platform launched by Hangzhou Future Speed Technology Ltd., dedicated to providing efficient, stable and secure one-stop model deployments and access services for businesses. The core strength of the platform lies in its excellent Heterogeneouscompute resources support and multi-engineer infusion capabilities.
sfafac1f1729a16: The platform provides comprehensive support to mainstream national and international companies such as Weida, Ascend, Hygon DCU, Cambricon, and others, in achieving a unified nanobaric and scheduling of heterogeneous hardware. Its unique multi-engine capability combines multiple engines with an optimised engine that can operate at the same time and provide optimal performance for different applications. Based on a high-performance distribution framework, Xoscar, Xinference has the capacity to operate steadily in megaclusters, supports multi-point distributional infoference, dynamic load balance and automatic failure recovery, and effectively guarantees the high availability of enterprise-level services.
